name: barbell pause incline bench press
description: Incline bench press with a stop on your chest. It builds upper chest strength without any bounce.
instructions: Lie on an incline bench and grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders.
Unrack the bar and lower it to your upper chest.
Hold the bar still on your chest for a full second.
Press up until your arms are straight.
Keep your shoulder blades pulled back.
